sections.Profile:
The "Struggle Buggies" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on November 20, 1953, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1953
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Racing, Sports, Original Theme, Cars
